messages.subject: [REMINDER]: Airflow Dev call on 7th May - agenda
messages.body:
Hi everyone,

Here is a quick reminder that we have our Airflow dev call tomorrow, on
Thursday, 7th May 2026 at 8AM PST (11 am EST | 4 pm UTC / GMT).

Proposed agenda:

   - Catch-up on action items from last call
   - Wiki update for Airflow 3.3 (Vikram Koka)
   - Airflow 3.3 and related Development Updates
      - AIP-103 update - Amogh Desai, Vikram
      - AIP-72 Multi-language support update (TP Chung, Jason Liu) - follow
      up from prior dev call
      - AIP-86 Deadline Alerts update - Sean Ghaeli, Dennis Ferruzzi
      - AIP-67 Multi-team update - Niko, Vincent Beck
      - TBD
   - Discussion topics:
   - MCP (AIP-91) & AI Assistant (AIP-101) - High-Level introduction
      (Shahar Epstein)
      - TBD



For additions to the agenda, please feel free to add a comment to the wiki
page
<https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=373886699#Airflow3.xDevCall:Meetingnotes-ProposedAgenda.38>
or
send me an email. The summary of the call will also be sent to the mailing
list and posted on the same wiki page.
As a reminder the zoom link is
https://astronomer.zoom.us/j/84124767391?pwd=3vatlR8OuF6Uy2JbOcKrw6034CayFG.1

Looking forward to seeing you all soon,
Vikram
-- 

Vikram Koka
Chief Strategy Officer
